top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walkthrough, an infant was observed sleeping with a bib on.     Note: The bib was removed immediately

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated in regard to an investigation and a violation was found. The operation did not know who they were responsible to pick up  on the day of the incident. As a result, the operation failed to pick up two children from elementary school.
